correctness.rationale: Explicit derivation: every proper weak ideal omits the empty team or has union U strictly below V and lies inside a corresponding coatom; each displayed coatom is maximal because adjoining a missing team forces empty team plus V and hence all teams. All intersections of coatom cones contract unless every coatom is selected. Their nerve is the boundary of an n-simplex, and the finite nerve lemma yields S^(n-1). Möbius follows from reduced Euler characteristic. Complete enumeration n=1..4 and recursive Möbius check corroborate and do not replace the proof.

value.rationale: The denotation-equivalence lattice is a canonical structural semantic object: homotopy and its top-to-bottom Möbius invariant measure the entire entailment organization, not an arbitrary finite slice. An exact S^(n-1) homotopy classification of this potentially huge lattice follows from an intrinsic n+1-coatom theorem and extends uniformly to every finite propositional vocabulary. It solves a natural complete-invariant question without a full census of formulas.
